identity.title: CRISPR-Cas9 screen to identify genes regulating cell death.

content.abstract: Regulated cell death mediated by dedicated molecular machines, known as programmed cell death, plays important roles in health and disease. Understanding the mechanisms of cell death is crucial for elucidating the control of cellular homeostasis and developing therapies for related diseases. Despite extensive research efforts spanning decades, many aspects of cell death mechanisms remain elusive, highlighting the need for continued exploration. Here, we describe how to identify novel regulators involved in cell death pathways using a genome-wide screening approach.
